document_dispositions.rationale: The supplied standalone-financial-statement chunk contains issuer-wide liquidity, receivable, inventory, contract-asset, financial-risk, and property-plant-equipment tables. The current 20-fact roster already represents the same objective-relevant corporate liquidity, working-capital, contract-asset, and capital-expenditure mechanisms on a consolidated basis, while this chunk contains no distinct HBM/DRAM pricing, capacity scarcity, customer commitment, qualification, revenue conversion, earnings bridge, or valuation fact. General financial-statement background is therefore not emitted again.
